faqs.question: Do you only build websites?
faqs.answer: No. The website is often where we start, but we build the system around it too: business software, integrations, automation, and an Evolve plan that keeps it improving.

faqs.question: What does every build include?
faqs.answer: Mobile-first design, a contact form, WhatsApp and call buttons, SEO setup (titles, meta, sitemap, schema), analytics, a custom 404 page, and a 30-day warranty.

faqs.question: How do the Website and the Connected Website differ?
faqs.answer: The Website uses proven layouts from our system, one revision round and a fixed page structure, in 10–14 days. The Connected Website is designed from scratch for your brand, with three revision rounds, and adds instant WhatsApp and email replies, online booking or callbacks and a dashboard of every lead, in 4–6 weeks, with three months of Evolve.

faqs.question: What is a System Blueprint?
faqs.answer: A fixed-fee study of how your business works: ₹10,000, in 1–2 weeks. You get a map of where it loses time and money, the system it needs in phases, and a fixed quote. The fee is credited in full if you go ahead.

faqs.question: Can you connect WhatsApp to our website and CRM?
faqs.answer: Yes. We use the official WhatsApp Business Platform through an approved provider, and connect it to your website, CRM, payments and email. Meta charges for some messages; we estimate this for you upfront.

faqs.question: Will my website show up on Google?
faqs.answer: Every build includes SEO setup (titles, meta descriptions, a sitemap and schema), so Google can read and list your pages. Climbing higher for competitive searches takes ongoing SEO campaigns, which are not part of any package.

faqs.question: Is the website mobile-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every build is designed for phones first, then larger screens.

faqs.question: Do you need my content before you start?
faqs.answer: For the Website, yes: content must be supplied in full before we start. This is what makes the 10–14 day timeline possible. For the Connected Website and larger builds, we shape the content with you.

faqs.question: Can you write the content?
faqs.answer: Yes, for ₹900 a page. Product descriptions for a store are ₹120 each.

faqs.question: Do you make the logo?
faqs.answer: The Website package includes a logo. A logo on its own, without a website, is ₹4,000. Brand identity beyond the logo is not included.

faqs.question: Can I add pages later?
faqs.answer: An extra page during the build is ₹1,800. After launch, a brand-new page is quoted separately; changes to existing pages are part of your Evolve plan.

faqs.question: Do you set up the domain and business email?
faqs.answer: Yes, for ₹2,000. The domain’s own registration and renewal are passed through at cost.

faqs.question: Can you set up our Google Business Profile?
faqs.answer: Yes, for ₹2,500.

faqs.question: Can you move my existing website to you?
faqs.answer: Yes. Moving an existing site to us costs ₹5,000 to ₹12,000, depending on the site.

faqs.question: Can you make my existing website faster?
faqs.answer: Yes. Speed optimisation for an existing site is ₹5,000.

faqs.question: Is hosting included in a package?
faqs.answer: Hosting is separate. It is included in all three Evolve plans, and the Connected Website comes with its first three months of Evolve.

faqs.question: What counts as one content change?
faqs.answer: One content change is one set of edits, sent together, to one page. Five staff photos on one page is one change. Three different pages is three changes. A brand-new page is not a content change; it is quoted separately.

faqs.question: What are the Evolve plan terms?
faqs.answer: Three months minimum, then monthly. Cancel with 30 days’ notice. You own your domain and your content, always, and get a full export within 10 working days if you leave.

faqs.question: What does the warranty cover?
faqs.answer: Thirty days from launch, and 45 days for Store and Custom. It covers defects in what we built. It does not cover changes you ask for later, edits you make yourself, or a third-party service breaking.

faqs.question: Do I own my website?
faqs.answer: You own your domain and your content, always. If you leave Evolve, you get a full export within 10 working days.

faqs.question: How do I know where my project stands?
faqs.answer: In your own client portal: the stage your project is at and what happens next, your files, the agreement you signed, every invoice and every request you have raised.

faqs.question: How does payment work?
faqs.answer: Up to ₹25,000: 50% to start, 50% on approval. ₹25,000 to ₹75,000: 40% to start, 30% at design approval, 30% on launch. Above ₹75,000: 30%, 30%, 25%, 15%. Work starts once the advance clears, and the site goes live on your domain once the final payment clears.

faqs.question: Is GST charged?
faqs.answer: Prices are exclusive of GST and no GST is currently applicable. Should Pixel Kinetix become GST-registered during the term, GST will be added to invoices issued from the date of registration.

faqs.question: What is not included in any package?
faqs.answer: Content writing, photography, videography, brand identity beyond the logo, SEO campaigns, paid advertising, social media, third-party subscription fees, domain registration and renewal (passed through at cost), and translations.

faqs.question: Are there any other costs?
faqs.answer: Only third-party ones, paid at cost or straight to the provider: domain registration, WhatsApp message charges, payment gateway fees, AI usage and app store fees. We tell you which apply before you start.

faqs.question: Can you deliver sooner?
faqs.answer: Yes. Rush delivery is 30% on top of the package price.

faqs.question: What if I want more revisions?
faqs.answer: An extra revision round is ₹2,000.

faqs.question: Who will I work with?
faqs.answer: Directly with the founder, Anand M, who designs your system. When a project needs extra hands, trusted specialists join, working to our standards, with one point of responsibility: us.

faqs.question: Do you only work with businesses in Bangalore?
faqs.answer: No. We are based in Kalyan Nagar, Bangalore, and work with businesses across India.

faqs.question: Do you run social media or ads?
faqs.answer: No. Paid advertising, social media and SEO campaigns are not part of any package. We build the system your marketing sends people to.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Message us on WhatsApp, call, or fill in the form on our contact page. We reply with a clear next step: a package, a System Blueprint, or honest advice.

homeBlocks.title: Technology built around your business.
homeBlocks.body: You run the business. We build the system behind it: websites, software and automation, engineered as one and improved every month.

homeBlocks.title: Track your project anytime, in your own portal.
homeBlocks.body: Every client gets a portal: what stage your project is at and what happens next, your files, the agreement you signed, every invoice and every request you have raised.

homeBlocks.title: Your price is fixed before we build
homeBlocks.body: Every package has a published price. Bigger systems start with a System Blueprint that ends in a fixed quote. Your scope and your price are agreed in writing, and work starts only once the advance clears.

homeBlocks.title: Clear timelines, written down
homeBlocks.body: A Website takes 10–14 days and a Connected Website 4–6 weeks, counted from the day your content is complete. Larger builds carry their own.

homeBlocks.title: Changes by message, not meetings
homeBlocks.body: Raise it from your portal in a sentence. Your Evolve plan sets how quickly it is done — as little as four business hours — and you can follow it until it is.

homeBlocks.title: Understand
homeBlocks.body: You tell us what is slowing the business down. We learn how it actually runs before we choose any technology.

homeBlocks.title: Proposal
homeBlocks.body: A fixed scope and a fixed price, in writing. Bigger systems start with a System Blueprint that ends in a fixed quote. Work starts once the advance clears, and not before.

homeBlocks.title: Design
homeBlocks.body: You see real screens, not a mood board. One round of revisions on the Website and three on the Connected Website, before anything is built.

homeBlocks.title: Build & connect
homeBlocks.body: Mobile-first, set up for search, and connected: WhatsApp, payments, email and your data working as one. Your portal shows which stage it is at and what comes next.

homeBlocks.title: Launch
homeBlocks.body: Domain, email, SSL, analytics and every automation, configured and checked. It goes live on your domain once the final payment clears.

homeBlocks.title: Evolve
homeBlocks.body: Hosting, monitoring, daily backups and a set number of changes every month, so the system keeps up as the business grows.
